name: MCP Server (local launch)
description: Connects to a local Model Context Protocol (MCP) server by spawning a child process over stdio. Requires process execution privileges, which are blocked by default unless running inside an isolated container that bounds child processes.

tools.name: mcp_list_tools
tools.description: Launch the configured local MCP server process and list its available tools.
tools.promptSnippet: mcp_list_tools launches the MCP server and lists its tools.
